about: Clips for the Equis demo film. Times are seconds within each clip.

landing.sourceSpace: 1600x900 CSS pixels (the composition's focus rectangles use these)
landing.shows: The Equis landing page from the hero: the headline, the chain figures read live from X Layer mainnet, a slow eased glide down through the first sections and back up to the hero.

surfaces.sourceSpace: 1600x900 CSS pixels (the composition's focus rectangles use these)
surfaces.shows: The "Three ways in" section -- one set of deployed contracts behind the dashboard, the Telegram bot and the MCP server -- then a hold on Exhibit B: the real borrow on X Layer mainnet with its hash, block, fee, and the note that borrow() verified the RedStone package onchain before the pool paid out.

markets.sourceSpace: 1600x900 CSS pixels (the composition's focus rectangles use these)
markets.shows: The collateral markets page: wNVDAx, wAAPLx and wTSLAx with share prices from RedStone's signed feeds and multipliers and balances read straight from the chain.

agent.sourceSpace: 1600x900 CSS pixels (the composition's focus rectangles use these)
agent.shows: The agent page: the EIP-7702 delegate, and the table of what a session key may do once granted -- scoped to named functions, capped in what it may spend, expiring on its own, and unable to withdraw or borrow.

explorer.sourceSpace: 1600x900 CSS pixels (the composition's focus rectangles use these)
explorer.shows: The OKX explorer page for 0xb896faa0..., scrolled to the input data, holding on the 1,700 bytes of calldata that carried the signed RedStone package.
notes: No input-data panel was found; the clip is a scroll through the transaction page instead.
